run.brief: companion app — approve builds from anywhere

screens.label: Story Mapping
screens.summary: Epic → Feature → Story map with MoSCoW lanes and release swimlanes — 42 stories in one sitting
screens.summaryPlain: The story map: epics, features and stories sorted must/could/won't, in release lanes — 42 stories mapped in one sitting

screens.label: Design Brief
screens.summary: The brief as a living doc — the surface inventory feeds the registry without rewriting
screens.summaryPlain: The brief as a readable document — its screen list seeds the app registry without retyping

screens.label: Moodboard
screens.summary: Curated references and captured shots per epic — every embedded shot verified on disk
screens.summaryPlain: Reference apps to steal from, with real screenshots per theme — every picture checked to exist on disk

screens.label: Prototype
screens.summary: Artboards at 390/744/1280 from targets alone — literal parity, structure not pixels
screens.summaryPlain: Every screen shown at phone, tablet and desktop size — same structure everywhere, no pixel-pushing

screens.label: Design Chat

screens.label: Freeze & Trace
screens.summary: Hash-locked freeze — the approval binds to the design hash; post-approval change goes stale loudly
screens.summaryPlain: Lock the approved design — your approval signs this exact version; any later change is flagged clearly

screens.label: Build Monitor
screens.summary: Narrative rail + one artifact large — the run is a conversation you can interrupt
screens.summaryPlain: A feed of what the build is doing plus one big detail view — you can ask questions or stop it any time

screens.label: Gates
screens.summary: The three human gates as a triage queue — reachable by agents, passable only by you
screens.summaryPlain: The three decisions only you can make, queued like an inbox — the agent brings them to you, never takes them

screens.label: Visual Fidelity
screens.summary: Design-vs-built probes per surface — SSIM, skeleton, ΔE against the frozen golden
screens.summaryPlain: Each built screen compared pixel-by-pixel with the design you approved — structure, layout and colour

screens.label: Pairing & Devices
screens.summary: One-scan QR pairing, device list with revoke — LAN-only by default, no cloud relay
screens.summaryPlain: Pair a device by scanning one code, see and revoke paired devices — local network only by default

screens.label: Notifications
screens.summary: Push on red gate, deep-linked into the gate card — approve from the lock screen
screens.summaryPlain: A push message when a decision is needed, opening straight to that decision — approve from your lock screen

traceability.story: Evan turns a client brief into an Epic-Feature-Story map in one sitting
Every surface designed at 390/744/1280 from targets alone (literal parity)
Pin multiple screens as chat context (removable chips); in-context screens outlined side-by-side at real device sizes
Start a build, walk away; stops on red, ESC_LIMIT=3
Three gates an agent can reach but never pass; approval is provenance-bound
One-scan QR pairing; a relayed QR fails the pin
Payment gate at first deploy: licence required to ship; everything before it free
